supporting_reports.evidence: A late flare in gusty winds led to a hard landing and a tail strike.
A bounced landing was followed by a hard second touchdown that damaged the nose landing gear.
An incorrect takeoff weight in the flight management computer led to early rotation and a tail strike on takeoff.

concerns: The proposed parent RE does not fit: hard landings, bounced landings and tail strikes are abnormal runway contact (ARC), not excursions.
